page_title: PSG 1-1 NAN | PSG v Nantes 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+3' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+2' Vitinha (PSG) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Here's the change. Pedro Chirivella leaves the pitch and Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes) comes on as a substitute.
87' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
84' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
83' 22:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
82' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) replacing Moses Simon.
82' Substitution. Matthis Abline makes his way off the pitch and Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) comes on as his replacement.
80' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
79' Ball possession – 84:16.

76' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Patrik Carlgren pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom left corner.
75' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) works the corner short.
75' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and PSG will take a corner.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean-Charles Castelletto departs the field of play to be replaced by Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes).
73' Substitution. Desire Doue (PSG) has come on for Bradley Barcola.
73' Here is a change. Kang-In Lee is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
72' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
71' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
70' An attempted cross from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared.
68' Nuno Mendes (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
68' Kang-In Lee (PSG) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

68' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to PSG.
66' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
65' Kang-In Lee (PSG) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
64' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Nantes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
62' The corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared away by the defence.
61' Substitution. Joao Neves will be replaced by Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG).
61' PSG keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
58' Kang-In Lee (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
57' Joao Neves (PSG) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Patrik Carlgren was alert and the score remained the same.
55' Kang-In Lee (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
52' Kang-In Lee (PSG) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

52' Nuno Mendes (PSG) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

50' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the left post. What a poor effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
49' Kang-In Lee (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
49' Patrik Carlgren displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Bradley Barcola (PSG) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Antoine Kombouare gives a chance to Kelvin Amian (Nantes) and Fabien Centonze is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' A rebound falls to Joao Neves (PSG) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.

45+2' Nuno Mendes (PSG) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Patrik Carlgren makes a great save to stop his effort.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' Bradley Barcola (PSG) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

41' Bradley Barcola (PSG) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
40' Kang-In Lee (PSG) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

38' 1 - 1 Matthis Abline (Nantes) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Gianluigi Donnarumma is just a bystander as the ball flies into the right side of the goal. The score is 1:1.
36' The percentage of ball possession is – 82:18.
36' Nuno Mendes (PSG) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Bradley Barcola (PSG) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Patrik Carlgren.
33' A lofted cross from Bradley Barcola (PSG) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

31' Kang-In Lee (PSG) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Patrik Carlgren was alert and the score remained the same.
29' Marquinhos (PSG) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
26' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) commits a foul and Jeremy Stinat immediately signals a free kick.
24' The corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is intercepted by Patrik Carlgren.

23' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Patrik Carlgren shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The ball goes out for a corner. PSG can continue in their attacking effort.
23' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Kang-In Lee (PSG). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.
22' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
19' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bradley Barcola (PSG).
17' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) latches onto a cross and shoots from close-range, but Patrik Carlgren makes a terrific save to deny him.
16' Kang-In Lee (PSG) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
15' Handball by Nicolas Cozza (Nantes).
11' Joao Neves (PSG) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
10' Vitinha (PSG) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Patrik Carlgren anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
9' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) forces a pass into the box, but Patrik Carlgren is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
8' Joao Neves (PSG) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
7' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Kang-In Lee (PSG), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
7' Nuno Mendes (PSG) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
6' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Patrik Carlgren is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
2' 1 - 0 Goal! Achraf Hakimi (PSG) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Goncalo Ramos, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
PSG will kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will officiate today.
